title: tidy --path works on a fresh worktree without --older-than, says by its exit code when a named path was kept, and refuses --class branch
goal: `backlog.py tidy --path PATH` takes the named path as old enough unless `--older-than` is given; with `--apply` it exits 1 when a named path was kept, naming why; `--path` with `--class branch` exits 2, since a branch has no path; the docs say a session cannot remove the worktree it runs in or one where its own process still runs, and name the working recipe

run:
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
env["KB_COORD_STORE"] = os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite")
def sh(*a, cwd=T):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
O = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"); K = os.path.join(T, "clone")
sh("git", "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O)
sh("git", "clone", "-q", O, K)
shutil.copy(os.path.join(R, "backlog.json"), K); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
sh("git", "add", ".", cwd=K)
sh("git", "-c", "user.email=a@b", "-c", "user.name=n", "commit", "-q", "-m", "b", cwd=K)
sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main", cwd=K)
sh("git", "fetch", "-q", cwd=K)
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "backlog.py"), "--root", K, *a, cwd=K)
paths = {}
for n in ("a", "b"):
    p = os.path.join(K, ".claude", "worktrees", "review-" + n)
    sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "--detach", p, "origin/main", cwd=K)
    bl("own", p, "--class", "worktree", "--sprint", "SP-aaaaaaaa")
    paths[n] = p
if not all(os.path.isdir(p) for p in paths.values()):
    print("check broken: the planted worktrees were not made"); sys.exit(2)
problems = []
r = bl("tidy", "--path", paths["a"], "--apply")
if r.returncode != 0 or os.path.isdir(paths["a"]):
    problems.append("tidy --path A --apply without --older-than keeps a freshly named worktree: exit %d %s" % (r.returncode, r.stdout[-200:]))
sh("git", "-C", paths["b"], "-c", "user.email=a@b", "-c", "user.name=n", "commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "unlanded")
k = bl("tidy", "--path", paths["b"], "--older-than", "0", "--apply")
if not os.path.isdir(paths["b"]):
    problems.append("check broken: tidy removed a worktree with an unlanded commit")
elif k.returncode != 1:
    problems.append("tidy --path --apply of a named worktree it keeps exits %d, not 1" % k.returncode)
c = bl("tidy", "--path", paths["b"], "--class", "branch", "--older-than", "0")
if c.returncode != 2:
    problems.append("tidy --path with --class branch exits %d, not 2" % c.returncode)
print("\n".join(problems) or "ok")
sys.exit(1 if problems else 0)
